author: Kauzar
body:
IGN: Juanoh/Kauzar (Both different accounts >.>)
Reason: Juanoh = Temp ban for scamming, Kauzar = Ban Evasion

Explanation: You may or not be aware of what happened but I promoted an OF cape giveaway around 5 months ago which later got converted into a scam from my side after revoking the prize and making PresidentBadger the one and only victim of it so yes, the first and I repeat, just the first ban was rightly given (The temporary one).

I'm assuming he didn't know I had swapped accounts 2 weeks prior the ban (Juanoh > Wecks > Kauzar) so that made him ban my former main account, which I clearly don't use anymore cause of the swap and yeah, 3-4 days after being banned I had still not realised I was banned and since I'm a ref I had to hope on the server to attend to my respective matches, making me ban evade without even knowing, 

Tazz found out I was banned right after those games ended so I just stayed quiet till now, that my main is banned but I can tell you in all honesty I never tried to ban evade, I was just not aware of the ban since I don't play on Juanoh anymore. 

It was basically all PresidentBadger's fault in the end, for not banning me on my main.

Thanks for reading and have a nice day o/

title: [Appeal] Juanoh/Kauzar

replies.author: Iron
replies.body:
Hello,

Thanks for your appeal Juanoh! After discussing your ban with the seniors, we have decided to remove the ban from Kauzar, and move a 14 Day temp-ban. Next time, just try and keep a tab on your other accounts. Furthermore, I apologize for the inconvenience. 

Thanks,
    -Iron, Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
